_meta.purpose: Hand-authored registry of the outdoor donor cell sites observed from the FCC HQ 7th-floor indoor walk (7/7) and the ground-level outdoor walk (7/24). Joined against the measured scan data by build_catalog.py to produce base_stations.csv (the transmitter definition for PR #26/#27 and the cross-validation ground truth).
_meta.note_gcp_naming: In this repo 'GCP' already means the floor-plan ground control points (Data/floorplan_meta.js). These antenna control points are deliberately named base_station_catalog to avoid collision.
_meta.azimuth_convention: compass degrees, 0=N, 90=E; direction the panel main lobe points (propagation direction FROM the antenna).

receiver_reference.note: walk-test receiver plane; used as the O2I height reference. The scan has no usable altitude column.

sites.name: Forte Hall
sites.address: Gonzaga College HS campus, I St NW, Washington, DC 20002

height.note: Rooftop panels on the ~6-7 storey brick building. OSM at this coordinate returns the adjacent glass 'Forte Hall' athletic building (education, height 3 m), which is NOT the antenna mount — so the manual estimate is preferred for the anchor. ~6.5 storeys x 3 m ~= 20 m AGL.

carriers.bands_note: Band 13 (751 MHz, PCI 396/397/398) is the primary validation case. '256' is unusual (no standard LTE/NR band 256) — recorded faithfully, likely a scanner artifact, to be confirmed.

antennas.note: Direction inference (infer_direction.py): clean single-lobe arrival ~261 deg (WSW), all four metrics + every band agree, near the site geometry (237 deg). Building-facing sector illuminating the FCC floor from the SW.
Direction inference: SW/W arrival ~267 deg (broad plateau spanning 237 deg), consistent across NR bands. Also building-facing. Inferred from NR bands (LTE B13 has only 2 points).

Direction inference: NO clean single-direction fit. Aggregate arrival ~285 deg (rho 0.44); bands disagree (LTE B13 best-fit ~90 deg E rho 0.52, NR ~270-285 deg W); site geometry 237 deg gives rho -0.27. Multipath/reflection-dominated (or LTE-396 != NR-396). CONTRADICTS the sticky-note guess that 396 faces the building -- the data shows 397 & 398 are the building-facing sectors. 3D reflections (PR #27) needed to model 396.

sites.notes: Highest-certainty site (known rooftop, known carrier, panel sectors). Distance ~415.9 m, arrival bearing ~237 deg to the floor plan (modes_3d.forte_hall_geometry). Direction inference (PR #26 extension, infer_direction.py): PCI 397 (rho 0.69) & 398 (rho 0.57) illuminate the FCC floor from the SW, matching the geometry; PCI 396 does NOT (rho 0.44, bands inconsistent, site 237 deg -> rho -0.27) -- correcting the sticky-note hypothesis that 396 was the building-facing panel.
